{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm that revenue is stored as string and has commas
print("Sample of revenue before cleaning:", sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:", sales['revenue_clean'].head(10))

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Check for completed orders
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_mask.sum()}")

# Filter: completed AND not internal test
filtered = sales[completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue}")"}
